macro_stages.name: Acquire inputs
macro_stages.description: Resolve, authorize, retrieve, and identify the inputs.
macro_stages.success: authorized, versioned inputs are ready for interpretation

macro_stages.name: Canonicalize representation
macro_stages.description: Detect, decode, normalize, and map the input schema.
macro_stages.success: the input has a typed canonical representation

macro_stages.name: Enrich context
macro_stages.description: Clean, resolve language, retrieve context, and derive evidence.
macro_stages.success: the task state contains sufficient cleaned and attributed context

macro_stages.name: Transform or act
macro_stages.description: Plan, execute, and reconcile the task operation.
macro_stages.success: a bounded plan has produced one candidate result

macro_stages.name: Verify success
macro_stages.description: Validate, independently verify, and adjudicate the result.
macro_stages.success: contract, outcome, confidence, and risk gates pass

macro_stages.name: Emit result and receipt
macro_stages.description: Package, deliver, and register the result and receipt.
macro_stages.success: the result and route evidence are durable and replayable

stages.name: Resolve source
stages.description: Resolve the task reference into a concrete source identity.
stages.success: the source identity and addressing mode are explicit

stages.name: Authorize access
stages.description: Attach the least authority required to read the resolved source.
stages.success: access is authorized, scoped and auditable

stages.name: Retrieve payload
stages.description: Read or capture the source through a typed transport.
stages.success: the requested bytes, records, events or state are available

stages.name: Identify and fingerprint
stages.description: Establish content identity, format hints, version and integrity.
stages.success: the payload is versioned, fingerprinted and safe to process

stages.name: Detect representation
stages.description: Determine the payload format without yet interpreting its content.
stages.success: format and encoding hypotheses are explicit with confidence

stages.name: Decode content
stages.description: Turn bytes or application state into typed decoded content.
stages.success: content is readable with source locations preserved

stages.name: Normalize values
stages.description: Standardize encoding, units, locale, layout and missing values.
stages.success: equivalent values share a stable normalized representation

stages.name: Map canonical schema
stages.description: Map normalized content into the task's typed canonical schema.
stages.success: required fields, identities and confidence are schema-valid

stages.name: Clean and protect
stages.description: Remove noise, duplicates and unsafe or policy-sensitive content.
stages.success: quality and protection policies pass with changes attributed

stages.name: Resolve language
stages.description: Detect, translate, transliterate or preserve language as required.
stages.success: language and terminology are usable by downstream nodes

stages.name: Retrieve context
stages.description: Attach relevant internal or external evidence with provenance.
stages.success: required context meets freshness, relevance and authority bounds

stages.name: Derive features and evidence
stages.description: Derive fields, features, predictions and reconciled evidence.
stages.success: derived context is calibrated, attributed and task-ready

stages.name: Plan operation
stages.description: Decompose the requested transformation or effect into a bounded plan.
stages.success: the plan is executable, authorized and budgeted

stages.name: Execute operation
stages.description: Run the selected function, package, model, browser action or subgraph.
stages.success: the declared transformation or permitted effect is observed

stages.name: Reconcile result
stages.description: Assemble, post-process, calibrate and resolve conflicting outputs.
stages.success: one candidate result satisfies the declared output contract

stages.name: Validate contract
stages.description: Check shape, types, invariants, security and effect policy.
stages.success: the result passes all mandatory deterministic gates

stages.name: Verify outcome independently
stages.description: Judge actual success using evidence independent of the producer.
stages.success: independent evidence supports an acceptance or rejection verdict

stages.name: Adjudicate confidence and risk
stages.description: Combine verdicts, uncertainty, risk and escalation policy.
stages.success: a policy-valid final verdict and confidence are explicit

stages.name: Package result and evidence
stages.description: Bundle the result, evidence, provenance and reproducibility data.
stages.success: the bundle is complete, typed and tamper-evident

stages.name: Deliver or persist
stages.description: Write the bundle to a declared sink using idempotent semantics.
stages.success: the result is durably addressable by its intended consumer

stages.name: Register receipt and checkpoint
stages.description: Publish the execution receipt, lineage, checkpoint and monitoring signals.
stages.success: the exact route and evidence are replayable and discoverable

solutions.name: Deterministic floor
solutions.description: A local, replayable route across all twenty-one atomic substeps.

solutions.name: Browser-resilient route
solutions.description: Separates browser source resolution, session, capture, action, and verification.

solutions.name: LLM-adaptive route
solutions.description: Uses models at distinct detection, decoding, mapping, planning, action, and verification substeps.

solutions.name: Accuracy-first ensemble
solutions.description: Combines hybrid schema mapping, evidence ensembles, search, simulation, and consensus.

solutions.name: Resource-minimum route
solutions.description: Selects low-cost local candidates at every atomic substep.

feedback_channels.name: Contract compatibility
feedback_channels.description: Rejects a route when any adjacent substep port cannot connect.

feedback_channels.name: Execution status and diagnosis
feedback_channels.description: Attributes a typed failure at the exact substep before recovery.

feedback_channels.name: Independent verification
feedback_channels.description: Keeps production and acceptance evidence independent.

feedback_channels.name: Quality and yield
feedback_channels.description: Updates uncertainty-aware evidence instead of replacing it with one score.

feedback_channels.name: Latency and resources
feedback_channels.description: Learns cost at candidate, substep, macro-stage, and route scopes.

feedback_channels.name: Cost and token spend
feedback_channels.description: Evaluates complete routes against the active objective profile.

feedback_channels.name: Policy, authority and effects
feedback_channels.description: Prevents optimization from bypassing permissions or effects.

feedback_channels.name: Provenance, drift and freshness
feedback_channels.description: Keeps priors version-aware, scoped, and replayable.
